items.name: Kampala
items.short: Solar power designed for Kampala's homes, businesses and grid realities.
items.context: Kampala's mix of residential compounds, commercial buildings and busy business districts each draw power differently — and like much of the region, the city deals with periodic grid instability that makes backup and hybrid systems a genuinely practical choice, not a luxury. A site assessment in Kampala looks at roof type and orientation on denser plots, available space on commercial premises, and how a property actually uses power day to day.

faq.q: Do you serve all areas of Kampala?
faq.a: We cover Kampala and the surrounding metropolitan area. Share your specific location during consultation and we'll confirm quickly.

faq.q: How soon can you schedule a site visit in Kampala?
faq.a: Timelines depend on current bookings, but Kampala is a core part of our service area — reach out and we'll confirm the next available slot.

items.name: Mukono
items.short: RayGrid is based in Mukono — solar solutions for homes, businesses and institutions across the area.
items.context: Mukono is home to our own office, so it's where we know the ground conditions best — from town-centre commercial premises to residential compounds and institutions on the outskirts. Being based locally means site visits and follow-up support don't involve long turnaround times. Mukono's mix of urban and peri-urban properties also means solutions here range from straightforward residential rooftop systems to institutional and small agricultural setups.

faq.q: Can I visit your office in Mukono?
faq.a: Yes — reach out via WhatsApp or the consultation form to arrange a time.

faq.q: Do you serve areas outside Mukono town?
faq.a: Yes, we cover the surrounding area. Share your location during consultation and we'll confirm.
